workload.note: College 2025 season: 584 rushing yards at 3.4 YPC, a decline from 2024 (1,088 rush yds, 5.3 YPC). Career Penn State totals: 5,586 all-purpose yards (program record), 3,451 rushing yards, 45 rushing TD, 102 receptions for 987 yards and 9 TD, 1,138 kick-return yards.

contract.note: Rookie contract; drafted by Tennessee in Round 5 of the 2026 NFL Draft. Pick number conflicts between sources: Titans' own site (tennesseetitans.com, Apr 25, 2026) states pick No. 165 overall; nashvillepost.com states pick No. 155 overall. Treating team site as more authoritative but flagging the discrepancy.

scheme.note: Titans hired Brian Daboll as offensive coordinator for 2026 under new HC Robert Saleh -- a full coaching-staff change ('Titans New Era: Saleh, Daboll'). Represents a significant scheme shift entering Singleton's rookie year.

competition.name: Tony Pollard
competition.status: RB1, entering final year of contract
competition.note: HC Robert Saleh designated Pollard a team 'bell cow' at RB (per July 13, 2026 Titans.com camp preview). One source (PlayerProfiler, ~June 22, 2026) notes Pollard will be 30 in 2027, heading into the final year of his deal with Tennessee in 2026.

competition.name: Tyjae Spears
competition.status: RB2, also called 'bell cow', extension uncertain
competition.note: Also designated a 'bell cow' by HC Saleh; positioned for a larger role as both runner and pass-catcher in Brian Daboll's 2026 offense. Approaching a pivotal/uncertain contract year with his Titans future undecided after 2026 (PlayerProfiler). Suffered a high ankle sprain in the 2025 preseason opener (Aug 9, 2025) and started the 2025 season on IR -- that specific injury is from the 2025 preseason, not current; per July 13, 2026 report he 'impressed again' in 2026 offseason work, implying full health entering 2026 camp.

notes: Titans training camp RB roster (July 13, 2026): Michael Carter, Julius Chestnut, Kalel Mullings, Tony Pollard, Nick Singleton, Tyjae Spears -- 6 RBs in camp.
Team expected to keep 4 RBs on the 53-man roster; Pollard, Spears, and Singleton viewed as 'likely locks' with the 4th spot competitive.
Singleton described as recovering from a 'college injury' (unspecified) as of the July 13, 2026 report; was initially limited in OTAs but 'showed improvement and comfort' in later sessions.
Draft-day quote from Singleton: 'I feel like I am a really physical back, a speed back, too...a complete back, too, can run the ball, catch the ball out of the backfield and be able to go block.'
